title: ACME Object Ontology
description: Semantic tagging schema for mapping ACME Object IDs (Setups and GfxObjs) to human-readable categories. Used by the AI agent for semantic constraint enforcement (Phase 6). Each entry maps an object hex ID to tags describing its architecture, biome, and functional type. Entries populated from the ACE source code (WeenieClassName enums, PropertyDataId.Setup references, and DAT file analysis).

id_spaces.setupModel: 0x02XXXXXX — 3D composite model (one or more GfxObjs assembled). This is what gets placed as a static object in landblocks.
id_spaces.gfxObj: 0x01XXXXXX — Single 3D mesh/geometry object. Building block of SetupModels.
id_spaces.environment: 0x0DXXXXXX — Dungeon room prefab. Contains CellStructures with portal polygons.
id_spaces.weenieId: Integer — Game-logic object type. Maps to a SetupModel via PropertyDataId.Setup in the world database. NOT a DAT file ID.

usage: Agent validates placement commands against biome/architecture constraints.
If an agent is instructed to build a 'Desert Outpost', objects tagged [Biome: Snowy] are rejected.
Object adjacency rules reference these tags to enforce aesthetic cohesion.
The weenie-based entries provide semantic names; the actual 0x02 Setup IDs are resolved at runtime from the DAT files.

tag_dimensions.architecture: Cultural style (Aluvian, Gharu'ndim, Sho, Viamontian, Empyrean, Generic)
tag_dimensions.biome: Environment compatibility (Temperate, Desert, Snowy, Swamp, Volcanic, Coastal, Underground, Any)
tag_dimensions.era: Time period (Pre-Sundering, Post-Portal, Modern, Ancient, Timeless)
tag_dimensions.scale: Relative size classification (Tiny, Small, Medium, Large, Massive)
tag_dimensions.creature_family: Creature race/species (Banderling, Drudge, Mosswart, etc.) — used for generator↔creature linkage
tag_dimensions.difficulty_tier: Level range tier: Starter (1-20), Low (20-40), Medium (40-80), Hard (80-125), Elite (125-200), Legendary (200+)
tag_dimensions.behavior: AI combat pattern: Melee, Caster, Ranged, Mixed, Boss, Passive, Generator

runtime_enrichment._comment: This section documents how to enrich this ontology at runtime when DATs are available.
runtime_enrichment.strategy: When WorldBuilder.Terminal loads a project, it can scan the cell DAT to extract all unique SetupModel IDs (0x02XXXXXX) that appear as static objects in landblocks. For each, it can read the Setup from the portal DAT to get the list of GfxObj parts, their bounding boxes, and polygon counts. This data can be used to infer scale, complexity, and type.
planned_features: DAT scanner tool that enumerates all 0x02 IDs and generates bounding box + part count metadata
Community crowd-sourced tagging via exported CSV
LLM-assisted classification using model part names from the DAT string tables
